messages:
Maya Chen: Heads up — while provisioning the new dedicated GPU pool in eu-west-1 we started hitting LB / endpoint quotas. Spinning up ~30 internal NLBs + a few ALBs for healthcheck/metrics and ran into target group and interface endpoint limits. Can cloud-accounts open quota requests? Account: 123456789012, region: eu-west-1.

Jordan Patel: Yep. Which exact quotas do we need bumped and to what numbers?

Maya Chen: Minimal list to start with: 
- ALB Target Groups per Load Balancer: bump to 200 (we currently hit ~60 per ALB because we create TG per service).
- Target Groups per Region (account): bump to 2000 to cover scale across clusters.
- NLB (Internal) load balancers per region: bump to 200.
- Interface VPC endpoints (AWS PrivateLink) per VPC: bump to 500.
- Elastic Network Interfaces (ENIs) per AZ / account: bump to 5k (we allocate a lot for ENI-backed tasks).
Also please add a note that these are for dedicated GPU infra (latency-sensitive) and include expected steady state: ~200 NLBs, ~1.5k TGs, ~300 interface endpoints across dev/stage/prod.

Aditya Rao: Also need limit increases for security groups per ENI if possible (we attach multiple SGs to endpoints). And request that the increase is for eu-west-1 specifically — we can keep other regions at defaults for now.

Maya Chen: Adding a sample description/template to paste into the support case: 
```
We are Redwood Inference (account 123456789012). We are deploying a new dedicated GPU fleet in eu-west-1 and require increases in ELB and VPC endpoint quotas to support 200+ internal load balancers and a large number of target groups and interface endpoints. This is for production traffic (low-latency model inference). Requested changes: ALB Target Groups per LB -> 200; Target Groups per Region -> 2000; NLB count per region -> 200; Interface Endpoints per VPC -> 500; ENIs per account per AZ -> 5000. Please approve or advise if we need to stagger the increase. Contact: maya@redwood.ai, pager: @maya.
```

Jordan Patel: I'll file now and ping once we have a case number. Will attach current load balancer inventory CSV.

OpsBot: Reminder: changes that modify networking quotas may require a maintenance window if they affect route table or subnet design. Please ensure tags: team=infra, project=gpu-dedicated, change-type=quota-request.

Cloud Accounts: Filed with AWS Support: case 1234567890. Link: https://console.aws.amazon.com/support/cases#/case/?caseId=1234567890 (EU-West-1). Requested values match the template. AWS initial response ETA 24-48h for quota review.

Maya Chen: Thanks — can you add a note asking if they can pre-authorize the increase for all eu-west-1 AZs and confirm if any sub-quotas (per-AZ ENI soft limits) apply?

Cloud Accounts: Added that note to the case. Also asked to escalate if needed due to production timeline.

Jordan Patel: FYI if AWS asks for justification numbers: we can provide the LB inventory + expected growth (sheet link) and that these are to support dedicated GPU inference pools (SLO: 99.9% p99 latency).

Cloud Accounts: AWS approved part of the request: ALB Target Groups per LB -> 200 approved. Case updated: 1234567890. Remaining items (interface endpoints & ENIs) require additional review, ETA +3 business days.

Maya Chen: Great progress. Please keep thread updated — we want to avoid any provisioning failures when the rollout begins tomorrow.

Cloud Accounts: Will update here when fully approved. Case notes: when approved AWS will apply changes account-wide for eu-west-1.

Jordan Patel: If there's any blocking, we can pivot some services to reuse tg/paths instead of per-service TGs as a temporary mitigation.

Maya Chen: Good call. Thanks team. :thumbsup:
